secoes.corpo:
It is an essential mathematical formula in nursing to determine the
exact rate 
of administration of an intravenous fluid, indicating the precise amount of drops or microdrops per minute.

The Variables: 
It uses the
Volume (V) 
total in milliliters (mL) and the
Time (T) 
in hours or minutes.

Macrodrops (drops/min): 
Uses the division factor 3 (for hours) or the multiplier 20 (for minutes).

Microdrops (microdrops/min): 
Direct division of time (for hours) or uses the multiplier 60 (for minutes).
